O03.6 is now qualified for the current nineteen authority producer kinds; all six original criteria remain unchanged. Consume docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/O03.6/receipt.json, the O03.6.3 process/source/artifact receipt and docs/policy-process-qualification.md. Real process kills cover PREPARE/local commit/remote COMMIT/local acknowledgement; acknowledged primary loss preserves witness state, and lost primary with unresolved PREPARE stays closed. A fresh signed barrier fences running admission and the actual packaged HTTP server without changing the old database epoch; restarting the old writer refuses startup. Exact event identity, restrictions, historic LocalOnly history and scientific rows remain retained.

O03.7 still depends on H03.1's exact versioned backup output. Implement closed restore, complete current-policy verification/replay, invalidation of restored capabilities, independent barrier and bounded drain, then audited retry-safe release/opening. Neither an empty witness, enrollment, a changed local epoch, an old snapshot, nor absent PREPARE rows authorizes currentness or ABORT. Existing code has no release/reopen endpoint. Preserve O03.2 identity/session integration, F03.4 stream/worker checks, O03.8 source-isolation rehearsal and institutional acceptance as open obligations. Do not reuse the legacy organization-recovery path.

Independent mode now requires PostgreSQL 17 transaction_timeout. The qualification repaired server-side phase drain in admission, finalization and live rollback resolution; the old client-only abort could leave active SQL alive until its statement timeout. Reuse the final artifact and its receipts, not the earlier diagnostic candidate.
